newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-PaineWebber details Applied upgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PaineWebber details Applied upgrade.

text.p: -- PaineWebber semiconductor equipment analyst Gunnar Miller confirmed he raised his rating on Applied Materials Inc to buy from hold.
-- Miller also said he had set a 12-month price target of $50 on the stock.

-- The analyst said he raised his earnings estimate for the fiscal year ending October 1997 to $1.95 per share from $1.80 per share previously. He also instituted a fiscal 1998 estimate of $3.25 per share.
-- Miller said Applied, the flagship of the semiconductor equipment industry, can command a higher valuation than 15 times his current calendar year 1997 estimate.

-- Noting how the group as a whole carries a price to earnings multiple of 18, Miller said he believes that "AMAT can trade into the low to mid 20s in terms of forward multiples, especially since other elements of the group already do so."
-- He said the company's fourth quarter earnings results released Thursday night were in line with expectations, as were future orders.

-- Other reasons he cited for his new enthusiasm for the stock included his view that Applied Materials' competitive position in two product lines -- Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and Etch -- "looks to be improving."
-- In addition, he said that, "We now have better visibility of margin expansion in the 1997 fiscal year."
